description: This file defines color constants, functions to convert color representations from Lua arguments, and registers colors in Lua environment for a Lua-C integration.

methods.name: lu5_register_colors
methods.description: Registers predefined colors into Lua global table 'colors'.

methods.name: lu5_hex_args_to_color
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal color string argument to a lu5_color.

methods.name: lu5_label_args_to_color
methods.description: Converts a color label string to a lu5_color.

methods.name: lu5_string_args_to_color
methods.description: Converts a string argument to a lu5_color, handling hex and label strings.

methods.name: lu5_rgba_args_to_color
methods.description: Converts numeric RGBA arguments to a lu5_color.

methods.name: lu5_args_to_color
methods.description: Main function to convert Lua arguments to a lu5_color based on argument type.
